description: The wah as a device: a mode (envelope, sweep or pedal), the band's frequency and resonance, an envelope's range, sensitivity, attack and release, an oscillator's rate or note value and depth, a mix and an output, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, the band's travel and curve and the worklet's source (the auto-wah of @audio/effect-autowah and the wah of @audio/effect-wah), with no panel and no audio in it.
name: wah-device
